translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
explanation_html: Revealed to comfort the Prophet ﷺ in a hard season. Ibn Kathīr: Allah will keep giving — in this life and the next — until you are content. Not that it is easy now, but that it ends in your being pleased.
explanation_vo: Revealed to comfort the Prophet ﷺ in a hard season. Ibn Kathir: Allah will keep giving — in this life and the next — until you are content. Not that it is easy now, but that it ends in your being pleased.
